mmfTotalInvestments.sourceTitle: Money Market Mutual Fund Investments: Total
mmfTotalInvestments.calculation: Published native USD / 1 billion. No interpolation, daily-flow conversion or substitution.
mmfTotalInvestments.coverageNote: OFR aggregate of SEC Form N-MFP month-end reported fund investments, native USD divided by 1 billion. A monthly holding stock, not daily flows or a complete daily MMF AUM measure. Current revised vintage.
mmfTotalInvestments.attribution: Source: Office of Financial Research, OFR Short-term Funding Monitor.
